After valid credentials are saved, enabled settings may also refresh schedules, empty classrooms, and public data automatically. See the full policy for details.
默认不保存。只有勾选并保存后，QMplus 账号和密码才会加密保存在本机的独立: Off by default. Only after you select and save this option are your QMplus account and password encrypted locally in a separate Keystore domain, for one autofill attempt on a trusted official sign-in page. BUPT passwords are never reused and details never go to this project’s server. You still complete CAPTCHA, MFA, account selection and risk confirmation yourself. Saving different details disconnects the old QMplus session; disconnecting or clearing local data also removes the saved details.
默认关闭。Wi-Fi 读取失败时，仅对可安全重试的只读请求尝试一次移动网络；可能: Off by default. If a Wi-Fi read fails, the app tries mobile data once only for safely repeatable read-only requests. Data charges may apply.
默认关闭。登录信息仅保存在本机系统 Keychain，与北邮密码独立，不上传或同: Off by default. Sign-in details stay in this device's Keychain, separate from your BUPT password, and are not uploaded or synchronized.
